init_XPUAttentionBackend: init the XPUAttentionBackend class with a model_runner and optional skip_prefill flag
init_forward_metadata: initialize forward metadata for all layers in the forward pass from a ForwardBatch
forward_extend: run the extend (prefill) forward pass using FlashAttention with KV cache and page tables
forward_decode: run the decode forward pass using FlashAttention with KV cache and page tables
init_local_attn_metadata: initialize local attention metadata for chunked attention with sliding window support
